name: DNA topoisomerase I

function.text: TOP1 encodes DNA topoisomerase 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activity and molecular condensate scaffold activity. It participates in rRNA transcription and DNA replication.

function.text: TOP1 encodes DNA topoisomerase 1. Based in part on similarity, it releases the supercoiling and torsional tension of DNA introduced during the DNA replication and transcription by transiently cleaving and rejoining one strand of the DNA duplex. It introduces a single-strand break via transesterification at a target site in duplex DNA. The scissile phosphodiester is attacked by the catalytic tyrosine of the enzyme, resulting in the formation of a DNA-(3'-phosphotyrosyl)-enzyme intermediate and the expulsion of a 5'-OH DNA strand.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TOP1 have been reported in basal cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma.
